next.gate: 0.4.9 ships only when the before/after lab shows less lag in every scenario, none gets worse, and all Windows tests and the soak test pass.

items.title: Browser call protection
items.detail: A call in Chrome is told apart from a download in the same browser; only the call is prioritized.

items.title: No more flip-flopping
items.detail: A call must last 6 s before Scorio acts, and fixes stay on for the whole call.

items.title: Honest benchmark
items.detail: Only differences it can prove; extra rounds when results are noisy; download test tries 4 servers.

items.title: Deep Tune with real load
items.detail: Video, downloads, uploads and page loads; faster rounds; the stuck Running card is fixed.

items.title: Smarter AI model
items.detail: 75,530 parameters (was 20,265), trained on 607,486 examples; 99.2% on real test cases (was 84.4%).

items.title: Why did I lag, pre-match check, ISP report
Sleep, wake and network changes
items.detail: Scorio pauses and re-checks its changes after sleep or a network switch.

items.title: Upload lag limiter
items.detail: Caps upload just below line speed so ping stays low while uploading.

items.title: DNS switch fix
items.detail: Never stays on a slower DNS; switches back automatically if it got worse.

items.title: Respect your own setting changes
items.detail: If you change a setting, Scorio measures it, explains any change with numbers, and keeps your choice.

items.title: More real training data
items.detail: Finding licensed public traffic datasets, games first.

items.title: Low-end PC test
items.detail: CPU and RAM measured on a 2-core, 4 GB Windows 11 machine.

items.title: Before/after lab
items.detail: Browser call plus download, game plus Steam download, call plus upload, slow line, Wi-Fi.

items.title: Soak test
items.detail: Hours of continuous running with restarts before release.

model.phase: accuracy per app type, real test cases
model.gate: Passed: overall accuracy and every app category beat or match the old model on real recordings that were never used for training. Games went from 0% to 100% recognized, big uploads from 72% to 99%. The real test set is still small (620 cases, one real game recording), so more real data is being added.

tests.lab_note: The before/after lab has not run yet. Each scenario will show lag without Scorio, lag with Scorio, and the measured result.

issues.title: Upload lag is not reduced
issues.detail: Ping can rise a lot while uploading.

issues.title: Deep Tune card stuck on Running
issues.detail: Workaround: ask swuab for the 3-line fix.

issues.title: Benchmark download shows 0.0
issues.detail: The download test server is blocked on some networks.

changelog.text: The Scorio app with live dashboard, tuning, benchmark, sessions, diagnostics, Watcher and one-click reports; combination search that keeps only settings that win on their own; Deep Tune; safer updates.

Testing never stops: TCP/UDP settings tested during games, calls and on battery; registry settings tested across restarts; IPv4/IPv6 preference per network; session reports; connection score to the game server.
21 TCP/UDP setting changes tested with evidence; instant updates; Revert-Scorio; Minecraft and Discord screen-share recognition.
Connection score; instant TCP self-tests; kept settings survive restarts; DNS switches on steady gains; low CPU priority.
Updates wait only for a game or voice call.
Measured TCP experiments during big downloads and uploads.
DNS checked every 5 seconds with instant failover.
